_doc: What `tools/capture-fixtures.py --scenarios` reads from public RPC into testdata/scenarios/accounts.json (PLAN WP-09 item 4). For each pool it reads the accounts arbx follows for it, as pools::boot and Registry::static_accounts derive them from the pool account: CP vaults, the PumpSwap base mint and the global fee config, the CPMM config, every token mint (boot reads their owners and transfer-fee extensions), the DLMM bitmap extension and the 7 bin arrays around the active bin (pools::DLMM_ARRAY_SPAN). The scenario tests (src/scenarios/) boot a registry from these bytes through the real pools::boot (served by a local mock RPC) and mutate them synthetically.

usdc.why: USDC/SOL on all five venues arbx prices: real layouts of PumpSwap (no creator, no virtual reserve), Raydium CPMM (the largest WSOL/USDC CPMM pool, by getProgramAccounts on 2026-10-04), Raydium AMM v4, Meteora DLMM (bin step 1, with a bitmap extension) and DAMM v2. Gf7sXM is the cmp2 'poisoned' pool (PLAN-ADDENDUM I-8)

bolt.why: The bolt trade's two pools (w5h2-p5#648, testdata/wallet/4bkYuxT94kc8....json; docs/research/wallet-synthesis.md section 5): 9dSMwFfP (Token-2022 with metadata extensions, no transfer fee) on PumpSwap 5VbavvxS (creator fee, signed virtual reserve, a 170-byte Token-2022 vault) and DLMM HYWKYZ1e (bin step 100)
